meta.description: Landing pages, corporate websites, custom software, platforms and SaaS products. Explore what Kodexa can build and how we work.

title: Your business needs more than a website.
lead: We create digital solutions designed to attract customers, improve processes and grow on a solid foundation: from a landing page to a custom platform.
itText: For products that already exist: a technical team that maintains, improves and evolves your website, system or platform on an ongoing basis.
agencyText: We collaborate with design, marketing and other agencies and studios as a technical team, taking part in the development and architecture of their projects.
note: Custom development is quoted according to scope. Tell us about your case and we'll reply with a concrete proposal.
pricesNote: Published prices are starting figures in US dollars (USD); the final price depends on scope.
